#!/bin/bash
set -e
DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source $DIR/lib.sh
ROOT="$(realpath "$DIR/..")"

# Check if we're on the main branch
CURRENT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
if [ "$CURRENT_BRANCH" != "main" ]; then
  echo "❌ Version bump is only allowed on the 'main' branch. You're on '$CURRENT_BRANCH'."
  exit 1
fi

if [ -z "$1" ]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 [patch|minor|major|<version>]"
  exit 1
fi


# Bump or set version for mono project
# uv doesn't have a direct equivalent of 'poetry version', so we'll update it manually or via sed
# Since version is already in VERSION file, we'll update pyproject.toml
if [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    VERSION="$1"
else
    # Simple semver bump (patch by default if not specified as major/minor)
    CURRENT_VERSION=$(cat VERSION)
    IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$CURRENT_VERSION"
    case "$1" in
        major) major=$((major + 1)); minor=0; patch=0 ;;
=== test candidate tags via manifest inspect ===
v2.4.0 -> missing
2.4.0 -> missing
v2.5.1 -> missing
2.5.1 -> missing

observation.command: cat /workspace/scripts/version.sh 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "=== test candidate tags via manifest inspect ==="; for t in v2.4.0 2.4.0 v2.5.1 2.5.1; do r=$(timeout 30 docker manifest inspect "registry.opencode.de/bpa/audiominer/audiominer/web-service:$t" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo EXISTS || echo missing); echo "$t -> $r"; done
